import sys
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce

def lcm(a, b):
    return a * b // gcd(a, b)

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    N = int(data[0])
    T = list(map(int, data[1:N+1]))
    
    # Calculate the LCM of all T_i values
    result = reduce(lcm, T)
    
    print(result)
